'''''Statistics Surveys''''' is an [[open access (publishing)|open-access]] electronic journal, founded in 2007, that is jointly sponsored by the [[American Statistical Association]],  the [[Bernoulli Society]], the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] and the [[Statistical Society of Canada]]. It publishes review articles on topics of interest in [[statistics]]. [[Wendy L. Martinez]] serves as the coordinating editor.

==Managing Editors==
* [[Jon A. Wellner]] (2007–2009)
* [[Lutz Dümbgen]] (2010–2012)
* [[Donald Richards (statistician)|Donald Richards]] (2013–2016)
* [[David L. Banks|David Banks]] (2017–2019)
* [[Marloes Maathuis]] (2020–2022)
* [[Wendy L. Martinez]] (2023–)
